# Osas Construction Group

> Licensed and insured general contractor in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. Residential and
> commercial. Interior remodeling, exterior replacement, concrete and outdoor construction,
> hauling and demolition, and seasonal landscaping and snow services.

## Business facts

- Name: Osas Construction Group
- Location: Pittsburgh, PA (serving Greater Pittsburgh, Allegheny, Washington and Butler counties)
- Phone and text: (412) 923-2092
- Email: osasconstructiongroup@gmail.com
- Pennsylvania Home Improvement Contractor registration: PA200902
- General contractor license: GC-2025-006171
- Insurance: fully insured; certificate available on request
- Estimates: free, performed on site
- Pricing: itemized written quotes — labor, materials and disposal listed separately
- Property types: residential and commercial
- Published rate: dumpster trailer rental $225 Friday–Sunday, dumping fees $100 per ton,
  trailers 6 ft x 14 ft and 6 ft x 12 ft, up to 3 tons each

## Services

- [Full Home Renovation](https://osasconstructiongroup.com/services/home-renovation/): Kitchens, baths, floors, roofing and siding under one contract, one schedule and one crew leader.
- [Kitchen Remodeling](https://osasconstructiongroup.com/services/kitchen-remodeling/): Cabinets, countertops, backsplash, lighting and the plumbing and electrical behind them.
- [Bathroom Remodeling](https://osasconstructiongroup.com/services/bathroom-remodeling/): Tile showers, tub conversions, vanities and fixtures — with the waterproofing done right.
- [Drywall & Painting](https://osasconstructiongroup.com/services/drywall-painting/): Hanging, taping, finishing and repair — plus interior, exterior, trim and cabinet painting.
- [Flooring](https://osasconstructiongroup.com/services/flooring/): LVP, hardwood, laminate and tile — with real subfloor prep underneath.
- [Windows & Doors](https://osasconstructiongroup.com/services/windows-doors/): Replacement windows and exterior doors, flashed and insulated properly at the opening.
- [Roofing & Gutters](https://osasconstructiongroup.com/services/roofing-gutters/): Repairs, replacements, seamless gutters and downspouts that actually move water away.
- [Siding](https://osasconstructiongroup.com/services/siding/): Vinyl and fiber cement siding, house wrap, flashing, soffit and fascia.
- [Concrete & Masonry](https://osasconstructiongroup.com/services/concrete-masonry/): Driveways, walkways, steps, patios, retaining walls, tuckpointing and chimney repair.
- [Decks & Railings](https://osasconstructiongroup.com/services/decks-patios/): Custom decks, porches, stairs and railings — proper footings, flashed ledgers, permits pulled.
- [Hardscaping & Drainage](https://osasconstructiongroup.com/services/hardscaping-drainage/): Paver patios, walls, fire pits and outdoor kitchens — plus French drains, grading and irrigation.
- [Landscaping & Lawn Care](https://osasconstructiongroup.com/services/landscaping/): Mowing, fertilization, mulch, planting, design and seasonal cleanups.
- [Pressure Washing & Gutter Cleaning](https://osasconstructiongroup.com/services/pressure-washing/): Driveways, patios, decks, siding and fences — plus gutter cleaning, flushing and inspection.
- [Junk Removal & Demolition](https://osasconstructiongroup.com/services/junk-removal/): Full-service junk removal, demolition and hauling — or rent a dump trailer for the weekend.
- [Snow & Ice Removal](https://osasconstructiongroup.com/services/snow-removal/): Driveway and lot plowing, sidewalks, ice management and seasonal contracts, 24/7 in season.
- [Commercial Construction](https://osasconstructiongroup.com/services/commercial-construction/): Fit-outs, build-outs, renovations and year-round maintenance for commercial property.
